idea-plugin.name: SinewSlim
idea-plugin.description:
Slims Java methods that have grown past the length cap (26 code lines or more) at the seams where the least data crosses.

  • Every method over the cap is marked on its name and in the gutter, with its verdict: slimmable, slimmable only by returning a record, bound to its class, or not slimmable (to be investigated for redesign).
  • Click the gutter mark, or Alt+Enter Slim this method, to see the proposal over the method: each piece highlighted, with what it takes and returns.
  • Extract… asks for one thing, the new method's name, and extracts the piece through the IDE's own Extract Method. Skip leaves a piece out and solves again.

The configuration is the project's .sinew-slim.yml, shared with the command line, the git hook and CI, so the IDE and the build always agree about a method.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 0.1.0: the inspection, the gutter mark, the proposal overlay, and extraction with only the name asked for.
